requirement.statement: The system SHALL parse a document-head `<Imports>` container with `<Import as="X" src="vfs://...">` directives, where `as` is an alias namespace prefix and `src` is a vfs path to a file or directory.

case.given: A document head contains `<Import as="review" src="vfs://@/defs/types/review/">`.
case.when: The import resolver processes the document.
case.then: The resolver SHALL load the referenced target and register its exported symbols under alias `review`.
`@/` SHALL resolve against the workspace root, `./` against the importing file's directory, and `../` against its parent.
The resolver SHALL collect and parse the directory's `.xnl` files as a type package in stable (sorted) order.

requirement.statement: The system SHALL resolve `alias:name` references in the importing document against per-alias symbol tables built from imported exports, reusing the existing loader export/batchLoad mechanism.

case.given: An import `as="coding"` exposes an exported node named `coding-attractor`.
case.then: The reference SHALL resolve to that exported node.

case.when: The resolver builds the symbol table.
case.then: Their exported symbols SHALL merge into one `coding` namespace.

case.given: Two imports under the same alias export the same id from different sources.
case.then: The resolver SHALL raise a duplicate-import error and SHALL NOT silently overwrite.

case.given: A document references `alias:name` with no matching exported symbol.
case.then: The resolver SHALL raise an unresolved-import error.

requirement.statement: The xnl-core import resolver SHALL accept a file/directory resolver interface rather than depending on xnl-vfs directly, so it runs without a filesystem.

case.given: A caller provides an `ImportResolver` with `readFile`, `readDir`, and `isDir`.
case.then: The resolver SHALL read all import sources only through the injected interface.
case.and: xnl-core SHALL NOT import xnl-vfs as a hard dependency.

requirement.statement: The system SHALL leave documents without an `<Imports>` container unchanged, preserving existing proto/Prefabs/batchLoad behavior.

case.then: The document SHALL be returned unchanged and existing loader behavior SHALL be preserved.
